title: Generic BLS Substring-Collision Safety Remediation
canonicalBaseCommitDescription: PR #173 / RESOLVER-V3-050 merge commit, origin/chore/clean-arch-structure tip at task start

rootCause.primaryMechanism: BlsLookupEngine.calculateTokenScore (Stage 4, findTokenMatches): symmetric substring partial-match credit (0.8) for either direction (recordToken.includes(inputToken) or inputToken.includes(recordToken)), with no distinction between a compound query matching a shorter generic record (safe) and a generic query fused inside a more specific compound record token (unsafe).
rootCause.secondaryMechanism: BlsLookupEngine.findIncludesMatches (Stage 2/3/5): alias-substring containment carries the identical risk one stage later; confirmed a Stage-4-only fix would not have closed the defect (fallback score ~0.786, still above the 0.75 accept threshold).
rootCause.thresholdBypassGap: SequentialFoodCatalogResolver's dedicated BLS generic-truth early-return gate uses a higher accept threshold (0.85 for inputType 'ambiguous') than the generic multi-source fallback decision it falls through to (0.75, ResolverDecisionPolicy.ACCEPT_THRESHOLD) -- a fix applied only inside the gate is bypassable for scores in [0.75, 0.85) on 'ambiguous'-classified queries. Confirmed via detectInputType('Ein Snack') === 'ambiguous' and the benchmark fast-path adapter. Fixed by applying the guard at both sites via a shared helper.

selectedPolicy.name: hasBlsGenericSubstringOnlyIdentity
selectedPolicy.appliedVia: guardAgainstBlsGenericSubstringCollision (SequentialFoodCatalogResolver.ts), applied at both the BLS generic-truth fast-path gate and the generic multi-source fallback decision
selectedPolicy.description: A BLS candidate is disqualified from confident acceptance when: (1) it has no genuine exact/whole-alias identity for the query (match.exact === false), AND (2) the query is not a whole-token match against the candidate's own normalizedName (every query token present as a complete, space-delimited token), AND (3) the query is still a strict substring fragment of the candidate's (whitespace-collapsed) normalizedName. Retrieval/ranking untouched; only confident acceptance is blocked, downgraded to an honest ambiguous decision with reasonCode BLS_GENERIC_SUBSTRING_COLLISION_RISK, best/secondBest cleared, candidates preserved.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Not generalizable; requires ongoing manual curation; forbidden without a complete governance/coverage case, which was unnecessary given a working general alternative.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Reverse-engineered score-delta threshold tuned to the target case
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Forbidden by task instructions; irrelevant here since bare 'snack' had only one candidate (no second-place score to compare against).
Insufficiently general -- the audit independently found 10 further real BLS records with the identical defect class, which a per-sourceId list would have missed entirely.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Globally disabling substring matching in BlsLookupEngine
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Would discard the entire safe sub_token_substring_query_specific direction (380 queries in the audited population, including RESOLVER-V2-010's approved Speck sub-terms) for a defect that only manifested in 11 of 13,055 queries -- disproportionate, unmeasured blast radius.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Blanket compound-word-never-accept rule at the BlsLookupEngine search stage
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Conflates discoverability with identity confidence; removes candidates from retrieval entirely, losing ranking/discovery value.

auditPopulation.methodology: Extends the RESOLVER-V3-049 14,690-query offline methodology for substring containment; deduplicated Set of: every unique BLS record normalizedName, every unique deterministic alias, every unique single BLS record token, every unique DeterministicFoodParser-parsed normalized query from the frozen 104-case representative corpus.

changedQueries.winnerName: Lasagnette mit Ricotta und Tomaten, mit Spinat, gedaempft

positiveControls.note: RESOLVER-V3-043 Phase A: bare Broetchen never wins via D771900
RESOLVER-V2-010; pre-existing unrelated MULTIPLE_CLOSE_MATCHES status untouched

residualRisks: sub_token_substring_query_specific (safe direction, 380 queries) and no_relation (479 accepted-before queries) were not individually reviewed for unrelated correctness issues -- out of this task's declared substring-collision-safety scope.

The audit population (13,055 queries), while large and reproducible, is not exhaustive of every possible user phrasing beyond the 104-case corpus; a future not-yet-identified bare-word/compound-token collision could surface, but the fix is general (not a per-case list) so it would be caught automatically without a new patch.
no_relation (fuzzy/plural-fold) matches remain outside this policy's scope -- a different match mechanism, not diagnosed as part of this defect class.

implicationsForDependentTasks.RESOLVER-V3-044: unaffected -- fix is entirely inside the BLS deterministic fast path; V3-044's owned cases never reach it.
implicationsForDependentTasks.RESOLVER-V3-047: Depends on updated to add RESOLVER-V3-051 -- candidate comparison must not run against a still-defective deterministic fast path.
implicationsForDependentTasks.RESOLVER-V3-048: Depends on updated to add RESOLVER-V3-051 -- Haiku live re-evidence must not run against a known-unsafe deterministic fast path.
